scheme_name: Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana
other_conditions: Eligible entities include local bodies, Panchayati Raj institutions, registered trusts, NGOs, and government‑recognized institutions.
The organization must have been operational for at least 3 years.
Ownership of 20 bighas of private land to sustain 250 male cattle is required.
A minimum of 3 years of experience in operating a cattle shelter or similar activities is required.
The applicant must provide a 10% contribution towards the project cost.
benefits_summary: One‑time assistance covering 90% of the total construction cost.
